attributes.board_name: Vermont Office of Professional Regulation – Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities related to the licensee's OT roles: CE courses (live, or web-based/self-paced with formal assessment of learning, AOTA articles), academic coursework, independent study, formal mentorship (one cycle only), Level II fieldwork supervision, professional writing, presentations and instruction, research, grant proposals, board/committee work; caps per activity in Appendix A of the rules. Synchronous virtual courses count as live (H.305, 2023).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 10 hours per full year of licensure (license held 1 year or less: none; more than 1 but less than 2 years: 10 hours).
rules.audit_note: Activities are reported on the Office's form with the biennial renewal; keep proof of completion. Waivers or extensions for illness, injury, financial or family hardship on written request; credits found not pertinent can be replaced within 4 months.
rules.legal_basis: 26 V.S.A. §3359; Occupational Therapy Administrative Rules §3.2–3.3 (eff. June 1, 2004)
rules.notes: Licenses renew every two years; hours must be earned in the preceding two-year period.
